questions.question: Explain in detail the Golden age of Syriac literature.
questions.solution_html:
• Golden age of Syriac Literature
  • 4th to 7 th century AD- Syriac literature covered all the areas- Biblical lore- commentaries
  • on the Bible- liturgy-apologetics- Theology- asceticism-history-lives of martyrs etc-
  • Many writers contributed- St. Ephrem, Jacob Aphraat, Mar Balai, Jacob of Serug- Ibas of
  • Edessa- Jacob Aphraats contributions- St. Ephrem’s contribution- Narsai-

questions.question: What is the significance of New Commandment according to Jesus? (1 × 14 = 14)
questions.solution_html:
• New Commandment: St. John 13
  • Towards the end of the ministry of Jesus, He celebrated the feast of Pass over- a well
  • arranged meal with his disciples- Farewell message delivered by Jesus- Given new
  • commandment- to love one another- At the time of meal Jesus washed His disciples feet-
  • he acted as a servant- at that time given the new commandment- description of feet
  • washing- dialogue between Jesus and Peter- betrayal message.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025
questions.final_answer: washing- dialogue between Jesus and Peter- betrayal message.
